sources.name: open-r1/OpenR1-Math-220k
sources.purpose: Recommended next valuation pool: existing DeepSeek-R1 math traces with completion/correctness flags. Start with a small, pinned sample of short numeric-answer word problems; long and difficult traces may not fit Granite's context. Teacher differs from the current V4-Pro API and must be labelled.

sources.name: nvidia/OpenMathInstruct-2
sources.purpose: Supporting GSM8K-style prompt pool. Filter augmented_gsm8k and numeric expected answers; its supplied solutions come from Llama, so regenerate with DeepSeek if teacher consistency is required. Do not assume augmented answers are independently verified gold.

sources.name: open-thoughts/OpenThoughts-114k
sources.purpose: Later skill-diversity source: use math-only records from its DeepSeek-R1 reasoning data. Mixed domains and long traces require filtering; not yet imported.
